issue_context.title: Feature: Display drive information in Details Pane
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

With #12549, folder information is now displayed when no item is selected. However, when in the root folder, the information display is incomplete regarding to the drive data.

A new controller should be created to display for more complete information. The information displayed in the `Drive Properties > General` are a good place to start.

![image](https://github.com/files-community/Files/assets/110472580/93bbfa9d-4d4e-4472-bf53-7ae6436eaa4d)


### Requirements

- When in any root folder, like `C:/`, and no item is selected, basic information about the drive are displayed in the preview pane.
- The information displayed should be matching the information inside the `Drive Properties > General`.

### Files Version

2.5.0

### Windows Version

Windows 10 (21H2): 19044

### Comments

_No response_
